name: Shadows of Trust
source:
The protagonist lives with his best friend, Terry, in an apartment. They both attend college. Terry is a womanizer, and the protagonist doesn't understand how Terry can be with any woman he wants! Though he, personally, only has eyes for one girl...

The protagonist has always been in love with Beth, and he finally got the courage to confess to her! But he never imagined what awaited for him after that... Does Terry already have his eyes set on Beth?

[From F95Zone]
translation:
主角和他最好的朋友特里住在一套公寓里。他们都上大学。Terry是个好色之徒，主角不明白Terry怎么可以和任何他想要的女人在一起！虽然他个人只看中一个女孩……

主角一直深爱着贝丝，终于有勇气向她表白了！但他万万没想到，在那之后等待着他的是什么……特里已经把目光投向了贝丝吗？

[来自F95Zone]
